summary.text: Melanie Stinnett is a Republican state representative from Missouri House District 133, which she has represented since January 2023, and is the Republican candidate for Missouri Senate District 30 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Melanie Stinnett lives in Springfield, Missouri.

She earned a bachelor's degree in communication sciences and disorders in 2008, an M.S. in speech-language pathology in 2010 and a master's of health administration in 2022, all from Missouri State University.

Her career experience includes work as a speech-language pathologist with PRN and TheraCare Outpatient Services, as vice president of therapy services at the Arc of the Ozarks, and as owner of her own business.
Stinnett is not running for re-election to House District 133 in 2026.
In 2023-2024 she was vice chair of the Healthcare Reform committee, and in the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Joint Committee on the Life Sciences.
